notes.title: 2025-6-13 UPDATE
notes.content: [p]1. New: Affix system for growth outside the game[/p][p]After this update, growth outside the game will usher in a new affix gameplay. After each game, players will have the opportunity to obtain a number of affixes with random attributes. These affixes have unique buff effects and can provide diverse attribute bonuses for the character. ​[/p][p]Players can embed the obtained affixes directly into the character. Each character can embed up to 6 affixes. By reasonably matching affixes with different attributes, you can create a unique character that better fits your own game style. The addition of the affix system has greatly enriched the depth and strategy of growth outside the game, allowing players to gain new surprises and growth after each game. ​[/p][p]2. Forecast of the official version plan[/p][p]In order to further improve the playability and strategic dimension of the game, in the future official version, we will make the following major adjustments to the game content: ​[/p][p]Martial arts and bond attribute optimization: Greatly reduce the basic attribute values ​​of existing martial arts and bonds to avoid the weakening of the early game strategy due to excessive attribute bonuses, making the game process more balanced and reasonable, and making every choice made by players in the game more valuable.​[/p][p]Expansion of skills and super skills: A large number of new skills are added, each with unique effects and mechanisms. At the same time, a super skill system that can be freely combined and synthesized is introduced. Players can combine different basic skills according to their preferences and understanding of the game to create their own super skills, which greatly enriches the skill matching and strategy selection in battle, and brings players an unprecedented combat experience.[/p][p]Rich mechanism affixes: More types of mechanism affixes are continuously added. These affixes can not only provide attribute bonuses, but also introduce new game mechanisms, such as changing attack methods, triggering special effects, etc. Players can explore different combinations of mechanism affixes to discover more novel game genres, making the gameplay more diversified, and every game is full of unknowns and surprises.[/p]
